lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters; clusters are organized into distinct vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, with increased spacing in the mid-lateral area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a coordinate-like lattice structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear ridges visible along the upper flank, characterized by sharp vertical luminance gradients with high-intensity upper margins and low-intensity lower margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two remora-like commensal organisms attached to the ventral region, posterior to the pectoral fin.
